description: Defines classes and interfaces for tensor expression statements in Torch's JIT IR, including statement nodes, blocks, control flow, memory operations, and external calls.

classes.name: Stmt
classes.description: Base class for all statement nodes in tensor expression IR, supporting visitor pattern and parent linkage.

classes.name: StmtNode
classes.description: Template class for statement nodes, providing accept methods for visitors and mutators.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a sequence of statements, with methods for modification, cloning, and traversal.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Represents a memory store operation in tensor IR.

classes.name: Allocate
classes.description: Represents buffer allocation in tensor IR.

classes.name: PlacementAllocate
classes.description: Represents buffer reuse without allocation in tensor IR.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Represents freeing a buffer in tensor IR.

classes.name: FreeExt
classes.description: Represents external buffer deallocation in tensor IR.

classes.name: Let
classes.description: Represents a variable assignment in tensor IR.

classes.name: Cond
classes.description: Represents a conditional statement in tensor IR.

classes.name: LoopOptions
classes.description: Holds options for loop execution, such as GPU thread/block indices and parallelism.

classes.name: For
classes.description: Represents a for-loop in tensor IR, supporting GPU options and nested blocks.

classes.name: AtomicAdd
classes.description: Represents an atomic addition operation, GPU-specific internal IR node.

classes.name: SyncThreads
classes.description: Represents a thread synchronization point in GPU IR.

classes.name: ExternalCall
classes.description: Represents a call to an external function in tensor IR.

classes.name: ExternalCallWithAlloc
classes.description: Represents an external function call with buffer output arguments.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for the statement node.

methods.name: accept_mutator
methods.description: Accepts a mutator for the statement node.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a statement.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating statement nodes.

methods.name: set_parent
methods.description: Sets the parent of a statement node.

methods.name: clone_and_replace
methods.description: Clones a block and replaces a specific statement.

methods.name: remove_stmt
methods.description: Removes a statement from a block.

methods.name: set_stmts
methods.description: Sets the list of statements in a block.

methods.name: cloneWithNewBody
methods.description: Creates a new loop with a different body.

methods.name: set_start
methods.description: Sets the start expression for a loop.

methods.name: set_stop
methods.description: Sets the stop expression for a loop.

methods.name: set_buffer_mapping
methods.description: Associates buffer mappings with loop options.
